records.display_isnad_ar: بسم الله الرحمن الرحيم أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو يَعْلَى حَمْزَةُ بْنُ عَبْدِ العَزِيزِ المُهَلَّبِيُّ، أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو بَكْرٍ مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ أَحْمَدَ ابْنِ دِلُّويَهْ الدَّقَّاقُ ؒ فِي شُهُورِ سَنَةَ (328) حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ إِسْمَاعِيلَ البُخَارِيُّ، أَبُو عَبْدِ اللَّهِ الجُعْفِيُّ، قَالَ:

records.ar: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو الوَلِيدِ هِشَامُ بْنُ عَبْدِ المَلِكِ، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، عَنِ الوَلِيدِ بْنِ العَيْزَارِ، سَمِعْتُ أَبَا عَمْرٍو الشَّيْبَانِيَّ ، يَقُولُ: أَخْبَرَنَا صَاحِبُ هَذِهِ الدَّارِ، وَأَوْمَأَ بِيَدِهِ إِلَى دَارِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ يَعْنِي: ابْنَ مَسْعُودٍ ﵁ قَالَ: "سَأَلتُ النَّبِيَّ ﷺ: أَيُّ العَمَلِ أَحَبُّ إِلَى اللَّهِ تَعَالَى؟ قَالَ: الصَّلَاةُ عَلَى وَقْتِهَا" قُلْتُ: ثُمَّ أَيٌّ؟ قَالَ: "ثُمَّ بِرُّ الوَالِدَيْنِ. قُلْتُ: ثُمَّ أَيٌّ؟ قَالَ: "الجِهَادُ فِي سَبِيلِ اللَّهِ" قَالَ: حَدَّثَنِي بِهِنَّ، وَلَوِ اسْتَزَدْتُهُ لَزَادَنِي) .
records.en: Abu al-Walid Hisham b. Abd al-Malik narrated to us, Shu'bah narrated to us, from al-Walid b. al-'Ayzar, I heard Abu Amr ash-Shaibani say: The owner of this house informed us—and he gestured with his hand toward the house of Abdullah, meaning Ibn Mas'ud ؓ—he said "I asked the Prophet ﷺ: 'Which deed is most beloved to God ﷻ?' He said: 'Prayer at its proper time.'" I said 'Then which?' He said: 'Then kindness to parents.' I said: 'Then which?' He said: 'Jihad in the way of God.' He said: 'He told me these, and if I had asked him for more, he would have given me more.'

chains.en: Abū al-Walīd Hishām b. ʿAbd al-Malik
chains.ar: أبو الوليد هشام بن عبد الملك

records.display_text_ar: حَدَّثَنَا قُتَيْبَةُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا جَرِيرٌ، عَنِ الحَسَنِ بْنِ عُبَيْدِ اللهِ، عَنْ أَبِي عَمْرٍو الشَّيْبَانِيِّ: عَنِ ابْنِ مَسْعُودٍ، قَالَ: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ: "أَفْضَلُ الأَعْمَالِ أَوِ العَمَلِ الصَّلَاةُ لِوَقْتِهَا، وَبِرُّ الوَالِدَيْنِ" .
records.display_isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا قُتَيْبَةُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا جَرِيرٌ، عَنِ الحَسَنِ بْنِ عُبَيْدِ اللهِ، عَنْ أَبِي عَمْرٍو الشَّيْبَانِيِّ: عَنِ ابْنِ مَسْعُودٍ، قَالَ:
records.display_matn_ar: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ: "أَفْضَلُ الأَعْمَالِ أَوِ العَمَلِ الصَّلَاةُ لِوَقْتِهَا، وَبِرُّ الوَالِدَيْنِ" .

records.ar: حَدَّثَنِي قَيْسُ بْنُ حَفْصٍ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الوَاحِدِ، حَدَّثَنَا الحَسَنُ بْنُ عُبَيْدِ اللهِ ، عَنْ أَبِي عَمْرٍو: عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، قَالَ: قَالَ النَّبِيُّ ﷺ: "أَفْضَلُ العَمَلِ: الصَّلَاةُ لِوَقْتِهَا، وَالجِهَادُ فِي سَبِيلِ اللهِ" .
records.en: Qays b. Hafs narrated to me, Abd al-Wahid narrated to us, al-Hasan b. Ubaydullah narrated to us, from Abu Amr: from Abdullah, who said The Prophet ﷺ said: 'The best of deeds is prayer at its proper time and jihad in the way of God.'

records.ar: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عُمَرَ بْنِ يُوسُفَ، حَدَّثَنَا إِسْرَائِيلُ، حَدَّثَنَا سِمَاكٌ، عَنْ مُصْعَبِ بْنِ سَعْدٍ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، سَعْدِ بْنِ أَبِي وَقَّاصٍ ﵁ ، قَالَ: (نَزَلَتْ فِيَّ أَرْبَعُ آيَاتٍ مِنْ كِتَابِ اللهِ ﷻ: حَلَفَتْ أُمِّي أَنْ لَا تَأْكُلَ وَلَا تَشْرَبَ حَتَّى تُفَارِقَ مُحَمَّدًا ﷺ، فَأَنْزَلَ اللَّهُ تَعَالَى: {وَإِنْ جَاهَدَاكَ عَلَى أَنْ تُشْرِكَ بِي مَا لَيْسَ لَكَ بِهِ عِلْمٌ فَلَا تُطِعْهُمَا وَصَاحِبْهُمَا فِي الدُّنْيَا مَعْرُوفًا} ، وَالثَّانِيَةُ: أَنِّي كُنْتُ أَخَذْتُ سَيْفًا فَأَعْجَبَنِي، فَقُلْتُ: يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ، هَبْ لِي هَذَا، فَنَزَلَتْ: {يَسْأَلُونَكَ عَنِ الْأَنْفَالِ} ، وَالثَّالِثَةُ: أَنِّي كُنْتُ مَرِضْتُ، فَأَتَانِي النَّبِيُّ ﷺ، فَقُلْتُ: يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ، إِنِّي أُرِيدُ أَنْ أَقْسِمَ مَالِي، أَفَأُوصِي بِالنِّصْفِ؟ قَالَ: "لَا" فَقُلْتُ: الثُّلُثُ؟ فَسَكَتَ، فَكَانَ الثُّلُثُ بَعْدُ جَائِزًا ، وَالرَّابِعَةُ: إِنِّي شَرِبْتُ الخَمْرَ مَعَ قَوْمٍ مِنَ الأَنْصَارِ، فَضَرَبَ رَجُلٌ مِنْهُمْ أَنْفِي بِلَحْيِ جَمَلٍ ، فَأَتَيْتُ النَّبِيَّ ﷺ فَأَنْزَلَ ﷻ تَحْرِيمَ الخَمْرِ .
records.en: Muhammad b. Umar b. Yusuf narrated to us, Isra'il narrated to us, Simak narrated to us, from Mus'ab b. Sa'd, from his father, Sa'd b. Abi Waqqas ؓ, who said (Four verses from the Book of God ﷻ, were revealed concerning me: My mother swore that she would neither eat nor drink until she abandoned Muhammad ﷺ so God ﷻ revealed: {And if they strive to make you associate with Me that of which you have no knowledge, do not obey them, but accompany them in this world with appropriate kindness}. The second: I had taken a sword that pleased me, so I said: 'O Messenger of God, give this to me,' and the verse was revealed: {They ask you about the spoils of war}. The third I fell ill, and the Prophet ﷺ came to me, so I said 'O Messenger of God, I wish to distribute my wealth, shall I bequeath half?' He said: 'No.' I said: 'A third?' He remained silent, and a third was later permitted. The fourth: I drank wine with a group of the Ansar, and one of them struck my nose with the jawbone of a camel, so I came to the Prophet ﷺ and God ﷻ, revealed the prohibition of wine.)

records.ar: حَدَّثَنَا عَلِيُّ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ، عَنْ عُمَارَةَ بْنِ القَعْقَاعِ، عَنْ أَبِي زُرْعَةَ: عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ ﵁ ، قَالَ: ([قَالَ] رَجُلٌ: يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ، مَنْ أَحَقُّ النَّاسِ بِالصُّحْبَةِ؟ قَالَ: "أُمُّكَ" قَالَ: ثُمَّ مَهْ ؟ قَالَ: "ثُمَّ أُمُّكَ" قَالَ: ثُمَّ مَهْ؟ قَالَ: "أَبَاكَ". قَالَ : فَيَرَوْنَ أَنَّ لِأُمِّكَ الثُّلُثَيْنِ، وَلِأَبِيكَ الثُّلُثَ. قِيْلَ لِسُفْيَانَ: [لِلأُمِّ الثُّلُثَانِ] فِي الحَدِيثِ؟ قَالَ: نَعَمْ سَمِعْتُ ابْنَ شُبْرُمَةَ يُحَدِّثُ عَنْ عُمَارَةَ قَبْلَ [أَنْ] أَرَاهُ، [فَـ] سَأَلتُ عُمَارَةَ، فَجَاءَ بِهِ .
records.en: Ali b. Abdullah narrated to us, Sufyan narrated to us, from Umarah b. al-Qa'qa', from Abu Zur'ah: from Abu Hurayrah ؓ, who said ([A man] said: 'O Messenger of God, who is most entitled to companionship?' He said: 'Your mother.' He said: 'Then who?' He said: 'Then your mother.' He said: 'Then who?' He said: 'Your father.' They consider that the mother has two-thirds and the father one-third. Sufyan was asked: '[Does the mother have two-thirds] in the hadith?' He said: 'Yes, I heard Ibn Shubrumah narrate from Umarah before I saw him, [then] I asked Umarah, and he confirmed it.')

records.en: Qutaybah narrated to us, Jarir narrated to us, from Umarah [ibn al-Qa'qa'] b. Shubrumah, from Abu Zur'ah: from Abu Hurayrah ؓ who said (A man came to the Prophet ﷺ and said: 'O Messenger of God, who is most entitled to my good companionship?' He said: 'Your mother.' He said: 'Then who?' He said: 'Your mother.' He said: 'Then who?' He said: 'Your mother.' He said: 'Then who?' He said: 'Your father.')

Khalid narrated to us, from Ibn Shubrumah, who said: I heard Abu Zur'ah, from Abu Hurayrah, who said 'It was said: 'O Messenger of God, whom should I treat with the most kindness?' He said: "Your mother." He said: 'Then who?' He said: "Your mother." He said: 'Then who?' He said: "Then your mother." He said: 'Then who?' He said: "Then your father."'

records.ar: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ كَثِيرٍ، أَخْبَرَنَا سُفْيَانُ ، عَنْ حَبِيبٍ ، عَنْ أَبِي العَبَّاسِ : عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عَمْرٍو ، قَالَ: (قَالَ رَجُلٌ لِلنَّبِيِّ ﷺ أُجَاهِدُ؟ قَالَ: "لَكَ أَبَوَانِ؟ " قَالَ: نَعَمْ، قَالَ: "فَفِيهِمَا فَجَاهِدْ " .
records.en: Muhammad b. Kathir narrated to us, Sufyan informed us, from Habib, from Abu al-‘Abbas: from ‘Abdullah b. ‘Amr, who said (A man said to the Prophet ﷺ: 'Shall I go out for jihad?' He said: 'Do you have parents?' He said: 'Yes.' He said: 'Then strive in serving them.')
records.note: The chain of this report was missing from the supplied English (it held report 14's chain); it is translated here from the Arabic.

records.en: Abu Nu'aym narrated to us, Sufyan informed us, from 'Ata' b. al-Sa'ib, from his father, from 'Abd Allah b. 'Amr, who said (A man came to the Prophet ﷺ to pledge allegiance to him for emigration (hijrah), having left his parents weeping. records.en: Yahya b. Bukayr narrated to us, al-Layth narrated to us, from Uqayl, from Ibn Shihab, Anas b. Malik informed me: that the Messenger of God ﷺ said 'Whoever wishes to have his provision expanded and his lifespan prolonged, let him maintain his ties of kinship.'

records.ar: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ الخُزَاعِيُّ ، حَدَّثَنَا حَزْمُ بْنُ أَبِي حَزْمٍ القُطَعِيُّ ، سَمِعْتُ مَيْمُونَ بْنَ سِيَاهٍ، سَمِعْتُ أَنَسًا، قَالَ: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللهِ ﷺ: "مَنْ أَحَبَّ أَنْ يُمَدَّ لَهُ فِي عُمْرِهِ، وَيُزَادَ لَهُ فِي رِزْقِهِ، فَلْيَبَرَّ وَالِدَيْهِ" .
records.en: Muhammad b. Sa'id al-Khuza'i narrated to us, Harzam b. Abi Harzam al-Quta'i narrated to us, I heard Maymun b. Siyah say, I heard Anas say: The Messenger of God ﷺ said 'Whoever wishes to have his lifespan extended and his provision increased, let him be kind to his parents.'

chains.role: The English translation reads “Harzam b. Abi Harzam”.

records.en: Mu'adh b. Fadalah narrated to us, Hisham narrated to us, from Yahya b. Abi Kathir, from Abu Ja'far, that he heard Abu Hurayrah say: The Prophet ﷺ said 'Three supplications are undoubtedly answered: the supplication of the oppressed, the supplication of the traveler, and the supplication of a parent against his child.'

records.ar: حَدَّثَنَا بِشْرُ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ، أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ، حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ شُعَيْبٍ، حَدَّثَنِي عُمَرُ بْنُ يَزِيدَ النَّصْرِيُّ ، عَنْ أَبِي سَلَّامٍ، أَخْبَرَهُ عَنْ أَبِي أُمَامَةَ البَاهِلِيِّ ﵁ ، عَنْ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ ﷺ قَالَ: "ثَلَاثَةٌ لَا يَقْبَلُ اللهُ مِنْهُمْ صَرْفًا وَلَا عَدْلًا: عَاقٌّ، وَمَنَّانٌ، وَمُكَذِّبٌ بِقَدَرٍ" .
records.en: Bishr b. Muhammad informed us, Abdullah informed us, Muhammad b. Shu'ayb informed us, Umar b. Yazid an-Nasri narrated to me, from Abu Sallam, who informed him from Abu Umamah al-Bahili ؓ, from the Messenger of God ﷺ who said 'Three (people) from whom God will accept neither ṣarf nor ʿadl (neither obligatory nor voluntary deeds, in one explanation; repentance and ransom, in another): the one who is disobedient to his parents, the one who reminds others of his favors, and the one who denies the divine decree (qadar).'

records.en: Qabisah b. 'Uqbah narrated to us, Sufyan narrated to us, from Suhayl b. Abi Salih, from his father, from Abu Hurayrah, from the Prophet ﷺ who said "A child cannot fully repay his parent unless he finds him as a slave and then buys and frees him."

records.ar: حَدَّثَنَا مُسَدَّدٌ، حَدَّثَنَا بِشْرُ بْنُ المُفَضَّلِ، حَدَّثَنَا الجُرَيْرِيُّ: عَنْ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ أَبِي بَكْرَةَ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ ، قَالَ: قَالَ النَّبِيُّ ﷺ: ("أَلَا أُنَبِّئُكُمْ بِأَكْبَرِ الكَبَائِرِ؟ " ثَلَاثًا، قَالُوا: بَلَى يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ، قَالَ: "الإِشْرَاكُ بِاللَّهِ، وَعُقُوقُ الوَالِدَيْنِ" وَجَلَسَ وَكَانَ مُتَّكِئًا ، فَقَالَ: "وَقَوْلُ الزُّورِ"، قَالَ: فَمَا زَالَ يُكَرِّرُهَا حَتَّى قُلْنَا: لَيْتَهُ سَكَتَ) .
records.en: Musaddad narrated to us, Bishr b. al-Mufaddal narrated to us, al-Jurayri narrated to us, from 'Abd al-Rahman b. Abi Bakrah, from his father, who said The Prophet ﷺ said: "Shall I not inform you of the greatest of major sins?" (He said this) three times. They said: "Yes, O Messenger of God." He said: "Associating partners with God and disobedience to parents." He was reclining, then he sat up and said: "And false testimony." He kept repeating it until we said: "We wish he would stop."

records.en: Khalid b. Makhlad narrated to us, Sulayman b. Bilal narrated to us, Suhayl narrated to me, from his father, from Abu Hurayrah, from the Prophet ﷺ who said "May his nose be rubbed in the dust, may his nose be rubbed in the dust, may his nose be rubbed in the dust." They said: "O Messenger of God, who?" He said: "Whoever finds his parents in their old age, or one of them, and then enters the Fire."

records.en: Musaddad narrated to us, Bishr b. al-Mufaddal narrated to us, 'Abd al-Rahman b. Ishaq narrated to us, from Sa'id al-Maqburi, from Abu Hurayrah, from the Prophet ﷺ who said: "May the nose of a man be rubbed in the dust if I am mentioned in his presence and he does not invoke blessings upon me. May the nose of a man be rubbed in the dust if he finds his parents in their old age, or one of them, and they do not admit him to Paradise. May the nose of a man be rubbed in the dust if Ramadan enters upon him and then departs before he is forgiven."

records.ar: حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ أَبِي أُوَيْسٍ ، حَدَّثَنِي أَخِي ، عَنْ سُلَيْمَانَ بْنِ بِلَالٍ، عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ هِلَالٍ ، عَنْ سَعْدِ بْنِ إِسْحَاقَ بْنِ كَعْبِ بْنِ عُجْرَةَ السَّالِمِيِّ ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، قَالَ إِنَّ كَعْبَ بْنَ عُجْرَةَ ﵁ قَالَ: قَالَ النَّبِيُّ ﷺ: "احْضَرُوا المِنْبَرَ" فَلَمَّا خَرَجَ فَرَقِيَ المِنْبَرَ، فَرَقِيَ أَوَّلَ دَرَجَةٍ مِنْهُ قَالَ: "آمِينَ". ثُمَّ رَقِيَ فِي الثَّانِيَةِ، فَقَالَ: "آمِينَ". ثُمَّ لَمَّا رَقِيَ الثَّالِثَةَ، قَالَ: "آمِينَ". فَلَمَّا فَرَغَ وَنَزَلَ عَنِ المِنْبَرِ، قُلْنَا: يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ: لَقَدْ سَمِعْنَا مِنْكَ اليَوْمَ شَيْئًا مَا كُنَّا نَسْمَعُهُ مِنْكَ، قَالَ: "وَسَمِعْتُمُوهُ؟ ". قُلْنَا: نَعَمْ، قَالَ: "إِنَّ جِبْرِيلَ ؑ اعْتَرَضَ "، قَالَ: "بَعُدَ مَنْ أَدْرَكَ رَمَضَانَ فَلَمْ يُغْفَرْ لَهُ، فَقُلْتُ: آمِينَ، فَلَمَّا رَقَيْتُ الثَّانِيَةَ"، قَالَ: "بَعُدَ مَنْ ذُكِرْتَ عِنْدَهُ، فَلَمْ يُصَلِّ عَلَيْكَ، فَقُلْتُ: آمِينَ، فَلَمَّا رَقَيْتُ الثَّالِثَةَ"، قَالَ: "بَعُدَ مَنْ أَدْرَكَ عِنْدَهُ أَبَوَاهُ الكِبَرَ، أَوْ أَحَدَهُمَا، فَلَمْ يُدْخِلَاهُ الجَنَّةَ، فَقُلْتُ: آمِينَ") .
records.en: Ibn Abi Uways narrated to us, my brother narrated to me, from Sulayman b. Bilal, from Muhammad b. Hilal, from Sa'd b. Ishaq b. Ka'b b. 'Ujrah al-Salimi, from his father, who said Indeed, Ka'b b. 'Ujrah ؓ said: The Prophet ﷺ said: "Bring the pulpit." When he came out, he ascended the pulpit. He ascended the first step and said: "Amen." Then he ascended the second step and said: "Amen." Then when he ascended the third step, he said: "Amen." When he finished and descended from the pulpit, we said "O Messenger of God, today we have heard from you something we have never heard before." He said: "Did you hear it?" We said: "Yes." He said: "Gabriel (ﷺ) came to me and said: 'May he be far removed from mercy who finds Ramadan and is not forgiven.' So I said: 'Amen.' Then when I ascended the second step,' he said: 'May he be far removed from mercy if you are mentioned in his presence and he does not invoke blessings upon you.' So I said: 'Amen.' Then when I ascended the third step,' he said: 'May he be far removed from mercy who finds his parents in their old age, or one of them, and they do not admit him to Paradise.' So I said: 'Amen.'"

chains.role: The brother of Ibn Abī Uways.

chains.en: Saʿd b. Isḥāq b. Kaʿb b. ʿUjra al-Sālimī
chains.ar: سعد بن إسحاق بن كعب بن عجرة السالمي

chains.role: The father of Saʿd b. Isḥāq.

records.en: Abu Nu'aym narrated to us, Salamah b. Wardan narrated to us, I heard Anas say: The Messenger of God ﷺ ascended the pulpit and climbed a step, then said "Amen." Then he climbed another step and said: "Amen." Then he climbed the third step and said: "Amen." Then he sat down, and his companions said: "For what did you say 'Amen,' O Messenger of God?" He said: "Gabriel (ﷺ) came to me and said: 'May the nose of a man be rubbed in the dust if you are mentioned in his presence and he does not invoke blessings upon you.' So I said: 'Amen.' 'And may the nose of a man be rubbed in the dust if he finds his parents, or one of them, and does not enter Paradise.' So I said: 'Amen.'"

records.ar: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ صَالِحٍ، حَدَّثَنِي اللَّيْثُ، حَدَّثَنِي إِبْرَاهِيمُ بْنُ أَعْيَنَ، قَالَ عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ صَالِحٍ: وَقَدْ سَمِعْتُهُ مِنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ ، عَنِ الحَكَمِ بْنِ أَبَانَ، عَنْ عِكْرِمَةَ: عَنْ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ ، قَالَ: قَالَ النَّبِيُّ ﷺ: "إِذَا نَظَرَ الوَالِدُ إِلَى وَلَدِهِ فَسَّرَهُ كَانَ لِلوَلَدِ عِتْقُ نَسَمَةٍ " .
records.en: Narrated to us ‘Abdullah b. Salih, narrated to me Al-Layth, narrated to me Ibrahim b. A‘yan. ‘Abdullah b. Salih said And I heard it from Ibrahim as well, from Al-Hakam b. Aban, from ‘Ikrimah, from Ibn ‘Abbas, who said: The Prophet ﷺ said: "When a parent looks at his child and it pleases him, the child receives [the reward of] freeing a soul."

records.en: Narrated to us ‘Abdullah b. Yazid Al-Muqri’, narrated to us Haywah, narrated to me Abu ‘Uthman Al-Walid b. Abi Al-Walid, from ‘Abdullah b. Dinar, from Ibn ‘Umar, from the Messenger of God ﷺ who said "The most righteous act of kindness is for a man to maintain ties with those who were his father's friends and loved ones."

chains.en: Abū ʿUthmān al-Walīd b. Abī al-Walīd
chains.ar: أبو عثمان الوليد بن أبي الوليد

records.ar: حَدَّثَنَا عَلِيُّ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، حَدَّثَنَا أَنَسُ بْنُ عِيَاضٍ، حَدَّثَنِي عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ يَزِيدَ بْنِ قُسَيْطٍ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ المُسَيِّبِ: عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ ﷺ قَالَ: "إِنَّ اللَّهَ خَلَقَ الرَّحِمَ شُجْنَةً ، وَقَالَ: أَمَا تَرْضَيْنَ أَنْ أُدْخِلَ الجَنَّةَ مَنْ وَصَلَكِ؟ وَأُدْخِلَ النَّارَ مَنْ قَطَعَكِ" .
records.en: Narrated to us ‘Ali b. ‘Abdullah, narrated to us Anas b. ‘Iyad, narrated to me ‘Abdullah b. Yazid b. Qusayt, from his father, from Sa‘id b. Al-Musayyib, from Abu Hurayrah, from the Prophet ﷺ who said "God created kinship as a branch (shujna), and said to it: Are you not pleased that I admit into Paradise those who maintain you and admit into the Fire those who sever you?"

records.display_matn_ar: أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ قَالَ: "مَنْ أَحَبَّ أَنْ يُبْسَطَ لَهُ فِي رِزْقِهِ ، وَيُنْسَأَ لَهُ فِي أَثَرِهِ، فَلْيَصِلْ رَحِمَهُ" .

records.ar: حَدَّثَنَا حَجَّاجُ بْنُ مِنْهَالٍ، [حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، أَخْبَرَنِي مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ الجَبَّارِ، سَمِعْتُ مُحَمَّدَ بْنَ كَعْبٍ]، أَنَّهُ سَمِعَ أَبَا هُرَيْرَةَ يُحَدِّثُ عَنْ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ ﷺ قَالَ: "إِنَّ الرَّحِمَ شُجْنَةٌ [مِنَ الرَّحْمَنِ] ، تَقُولُ: يَا رَبِّ، إِنِّي ظُلِمْتُ، إِنِّي قُطِعْتُ، يَا رَبِّ، يَا رَبِّ، يَا رَبِّ، فَيُجِيبُهَا، أَلَا تَرْضَيْنَ أَنْ أَقْطَعَ مَنْ قَطَعَكِ، وَأَصِلَ مَنْ وَصَلَكِ؟ " .
records.en: Narrated to us Hajjaj b. Minhal, [narrated to us Shu‘bah, informed me Muhammad b. ‘Abd Al-Jabbar, I heard Muhammad b. Ka‘b], that he heard Abu Hurayrah narrate from the Messenger of God ﷺ who said "Kinship is a branch from the Most Merciful. It says: O Lord, I have been wronged; I have been severed. O Lord, O Lord, O Lord. He responds: Are you not pleased that I sever those who sever you and maintain those who maintain you?"

records.ar: حَدَّثَنَا سُلَيْمَانُ بْنُ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ الدِّمَشْقِيُّ ، حَدَّثَنَا سُلَيْمَانُ بْنُ عُتْبَةَ ، حَدَّثَنَا يُونُسُ بْنُ مَيْسَرَةَ، عَنْ أَبِي إِدْرِيسَ الخَوْلَانِيِّ : عَنْ أَبِي الدَّرْدَاءِ ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ ﷺ قَالَ: "لَا يَدْخُلُ الجَنَّةَ عَاقٌّ، وَلَا مُدْمِنُ خَمْرٍ، وَلَا مُكَذِّبٌ بِالقَدَرِ" .
records.en: Narrated to us Sulayman b. ‘Abd Al-Rahman Ad-Dimashqi, narrated to us Sulayman b. ‘Utbah, narrated to us Yunus b. Maysarah, from Abu Idris Al-Khawlani, from Abu Ad-Darda’, from the Prophet ﷺ who said "The disobedient, the habitual drinker, and the one who denies predestination will not enter Paradise."

records.ar: حَدَّثَنَا قَيْسُ بْنُ حَفْصٍ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الوَاحِدِ، حَدَّثَنَا الحَسَنُ بْنُ عَمْرٍو الفُقَيْمِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا مُجَاهِدٌ، سَمِعْتُ عَبْدَ اللَّهِ بْنَ عَمْرٍو، قَالَ: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ: "لَيْسَ الوَاصِلُ بِالمُكَافِئِ، وَلَكِنَّ الوَاصِلَ الَّذِي تُقْطَعُ رَحِمُهُ فَيَصِلَهَا" .
records.en: Narrated to us Qays b. Hafs, narrated to us ‘Abd Al-Wahid, narrated to us Al-Hasan b. ‘Amr Al-Fuqaymi, narrated to us Mujahid, I heard ‘Abdullah b. ‘Amr say: The Messenger of God ﷺ said "The one who maintains ties is not the one who merely repays. Rather, the one who maintains ties is the one whose kinship is severed, yet he maintains it."

records.ar: حَدَّثَنَا سَعِيدُ بْنُ أَبِي مَرْيَمَ، حَدَّثَنَا سُلَيْمَانُ بْنُ بِلَالٍ، أَخْبَرَنِي مُعَاوِيَةُ بْنُ أَبِي مُزَرِّدٍ، عَنْ يَزِيدَ بْنِ رُومَانَ، عَنْ عُرْوَةَ: عَنْ عَائِشَةَ زَوْجَ النَّبِيِّ ﷺ ورَضِيَ عَنْهَا ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ ﷺ قَالَ: "الرَّحِمُ شِجْنَةٌ، فَمَنْ وَصَلَهَا وَصَلْتُهُ، وَمَنْ قَطَعَهَا قَطَعْتُهُ" .
records.en: Narrated to us Sa‘id b. Abi Maryam, narrated to us Sulayman b. Bilal, informed me Mu‘awiyah b. Abi Muzarrid, from Yazid b. Ruman, from ‘Urwah, from ‘Aishah, the wife of the Prophet ﷺ ؓ from the Prophet ﷺ who said "Kinship is a branch. Whoever maintains it, I will maintain ties with them, and whoever severs it, I will sever ties with them."

records.ar: حَدَّثَنَا عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ مُوسَى، أَخْبَرَنَا سُلَيْمَانُ، هُوَ: ابْنُ زَيْدٍ المُحَارِبِيُّ، أَبُو إِدَامٍ، قَالَ: سَمِعْتُ عَبْدَ اللَّهِ بْنَ أَبِي أَوْفَى ﵁ : عَنِ النَّبِيِّ ﷺ قَالَ: "إِنَّ الرَّحْمَةَ لَا تَنْزِلُ عَلَى قَوْمٍ فِيهِمْ قَاطِعُ رَحِمٍ" .
records.en: Narrated to us ‘Ubaydullah b. Musa, informed us Sulayman, who is Ibn Zayd Al-Muharibi Abu Idam, who said: I heard ‘Abdullah b. Abi Awfa ؓ from the Prophet ﷺ who said "Mercy does not descend upon a people among whom is one who severs kinship ties."

records.ar: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ صَالِحٍ، حَدَّثَنِي اللَّيْثُ، حَدَّثَنِي عُقَيْلٌ، عَنْ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ، أَخْبَرَنِي مُحَمَّدُ [بْنُ جُبَيْرِ] بْنِ مُطْعِمٍ، أَنَّ جُبَيْرَ بْنَ مُطْعِمٍ، أَخْبَرَهُ: أَنَّهُ سَمِعَ النَّبِيَّ ﷺ يَقُولُ: "لَا يَدْخُلُ الجَنَّةَ قَاطِعٌ" .
records.en: Narrated to us ‘Abdullah b. Salih, narrated to me Al-Layth, narrated to me ‘Uqayl, from Ibn Shihab, informed me Muhammad [ibn Jubayr] b. Mut‘im, that Jubayr b. Mut‘im informed him that he heard the Prophet ﷺ say: "The one who severs ties will not enter Paradise."

records.ar: حَدَّثَنَا حَفْصُ بْنُ عُمَرَ النُّمَيْرِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ عَبْدِ الجَبَّارِ، سَمِعْتُ مُحَمَّدَ بْنَ كَعْبٍ يُحَدِّثُ، أَنَّهُ سَمِعَ أَبَا هُرَيْرَةَ: عَنِ النَّبِيِّ ﷺ قَالَ: "إِنَّ الرَّحِمَ شُجْنَةٌ [مِنَ الرَّحْمَنِ]، تَقُولُ: يَا رَبِّ، إِنِّي قُطِعْتُ، يَا رَبِّ، ظُلِمْتُ، يَا رَبِّ، يَا رَبِّ، يَا رَبِّ، فَيُجِيبُهَا: أَلَا تَرْضَيْنَ أَنْ أَقْطَعَ مَنْ قَطَعَكِ، وَأَصِلَ مَنْ وَصَلَكِ؟ " .
records.en: Narrated to us Hafs b. ‘Umar An-Numayri, narrated to us Shu‘bah, from Muhammad b. ‘Abd Al-Jabbar, I heard Muhammad b. Ka‘b narrate that he heard Abu Hurayrah from the Prophet ﷺ who said "Kinship is a branch from the Most Merciful. It says: O Lord, I have been severed; O Lord, I have been wronged; O Lord, O Lord, O Lord. He responds: Are you not pleased that I sever those who sever you and maintain those who maintain you?"

records.ar: حَدَّثَنَا عَلِيُّ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ ، حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ ، قَالَ: قَالَ إِبْرَاهِيمُ التَّيْمِيُّ ؒ : "مَثَّلْتُ نَفْسِي فِي الجَنَّةِ، آكُلُ مِنْ طَعَامِهَا، وَأَشْرَبُ مِنْ شَرَابِهَا، وَأُجَاوِرَ مَنْ فِيهَا، وَأُصِيبُ مَا أَشْتَهِي، ثُمَّ قُلْتُ: أَيْ نَفْسُ، تَمَنِّي، قَالَتْ: أَتَمَنَّى أَنْ أَرْجِعَ إِلَى الدُّنْيَا فَأَزْدَادَ مِنَ العَمَلِ كَيْمَا أَزْدَادَ مِنَ الثَّوَابِ. ثُمَّ مَثَّلْتُ نَفْسِي فِي النَّارِ، آكُلُ مِنْ زَقُّومِهَا ، وَأَشْرَبُ مِنْ حَمِيمِهَا ، [وَأُجَاوِرَ مَنْ فِيهَا] ، ثُمَّ قُلْتُ: أَيْ نَفْسُ، تَمَنِّي، قَالَتْ: أَتَمَنَّى أَنْ أَرْجِعَ إِلَى الدُّنْيَا فَأَتُوبَ كَيْمَا أَنْجُوَ مِمَّا أَنَا فِيهِ، فَقُلْتُ لَهَا: أَيْ نَفْسُ، فَأَنْتِ فِي أُمْنِيَّتَكِ فَاعْمَلِي) .
records.en: Narrated to us ‘Ali b. ‘Abdullah, narrated to us Sufyan, who said Ibrahim At-Taymi ؒ said: "I imagined myself in Paradise, eating from its food, drinking from its drink, living among its inhabitants, and obtaining what I desire. Then I said: O soul, make a wish. It said: I wish to return to the world to do more deeds so that I may increase my reward. Then I imagined myself in the Fire, eating from its Zaqqūm (the bitter, cursed tree), drinking from its boiling water, [living among its inhabitants]. Then I said: O soul, make a wish. It said I wish to return to the world to repent so that I may be saved from what I am in. So I said to it: O soul, you are in your wish, so act."

chains.role: The speaker of the report.

records.en: Narrated to us Adam, narrated to us Shu‘bah, from ‘Amr b. Dinar, from Jabir ؓ that the Prophet ﷺ said "If one of you comes while the Imam is delivering the sermon, let them pray two rak‘ahs."

records.ar: قَالَ البُخَارِيُّ: "وَبِهِ نَأْخُذُ". قَالَ البُخَارِيُّ: قَالَ سُفْيَانُ بْنُ عُيَيْنَةَ: (مَنْ لَا يَعْلَمُ، وَيَعْلَمُ أَنَّهُ لَا يَعْلَمُ، فَهُوَ عَالِمٌ) .
records.en: Al-Bukhari said "And we adopt this." Al-Bukhari said: Sufyan b. ‘Uyaynah said: "Whoever does not know and knows that they do not know is a scholar."

records.ar: حَدَّثَنَا أَحْمَدُ بْنُ حُمَيْدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرٍ ، عَنْ أَبِي حَصِينٍ، عَنْ أَبِي صَالِحٍ: عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، قَالَ: "جَاءَ رَجُلٌ إِلَى النَّبِيِّ ﷺ، فَقَالَ: يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ، أَوْصِنِي وَأَقْلِلْ لَعَلِّي أَعِيَهُ، قَالَ: "لَا تَغْضَبْ ، فَسَأَلَهُ مَرَّةً أَوْ مَرَّتَيْنِ، كُلُّ ذَلِكَ يَقُولُ: لَا تَغْضَبْ" .
records.en: Narrated to us Ahmad b. Humayd, narrated to us Abu Bakr, from Abu Hasin, from Abu Salih, from Abu Hurayrah, who said "A man came to the Prophet ﷺ and said: O Messenger of God, advise me and keep it brief so I may remember it. He said: 'Do not get angry.' The man asked him once or twice, and each time he said: 'Do not get angry.'"

records.ar: حَدَّثَنَا مُسَدَّدٌ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو الأَحْوَصِ، عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ مَسْرُوقٍ، عَنْ أَبِي حَازِمٍ: عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ ﵁، قَالَ: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ: "لَيْسَ الشَّدِيدُ مَنْ غَلَبَ النَّاسَ، وَلَكِنَّ الشَّدِيدَ مَنْ غَلَبَ نَفْسَهُ" .
records.en: Narrated to us Musaddad, narrated to us Abu Al-Ahwas, from Sa‘id b. Masruq, from Abu Hazim, from Abu Hurayrah ؓ who said The Messenger of God ﷺ said: "The strong one is not the one who overpowers people, but the strong one is the one who controls their own self."

records.en: Narrated to us Muhammad b. Al-Muqatil, narrated to us [‘Abdullah b. Ibrahim b. ‘Umar b. Kaysan, from his father], who said "Ibn Abi Najih ؒ remained for thirty years without uttering a word that would offend his companion."

records.en: Muhammad b. Salaam narrated from Ibn Uyaynah, [who said ]: "Do you know what 'As-Salam' (peace) is? 'As-Salam' means: You are safe from me, you are secure from me."

records.ar: سَمِعْتُ أَبَا عَبْدِ اللَّهِ المُسْنَدِيَّ ، يَقُولُ: جَاءَ سَلْمُ بْنُ سَالِمٍ إِلَى ابْنِ عُيَيْنَةَ ؒ، فَجَعَلَ يُسْمِعُهُ يَقُولُ: فَعَلْتَ كَذَا، وَفَعَلْتَ كَذَا، قَالَ: فَنَظَرَ إِلَيْهِ ابْنُ عُيَيْنَةَ، فَقَالَ: أَشْفَانِي مِنْكَ عَقْلُكَ، قَالَ اللَّهُ ﷻ: {وَأَعْرِضْ عَنِ الْجَاهِلِينَ}) .
records.en: I heard Abu Abdillah al-Musnadi say: Salm b. Salim came to Ibn Uyaynah ؒ and began saying to him: "You did such and such, you did such and such." He said Ibn Uyaynah looked at him and said "Your intellect has spared me from you." God ﷻ said: {And turn away from the ignorant.}

records.en: Musaddad narrated to us, Yahya b. Sa’id narrated to us, from Thawr, Habib b. Ubayd narrated to me: from al-Miqdam b. Ma’di Karib, who had met him, he said The Prophet ﷺ said: "If one of you loves his brother, let him inform him that he loves him."

records.en: I heard Musa b. Isma’il, I heard Abu Asim say: "I have not backbitten anyone since I learned that backbiting harms its people."

chains.role: Al-Bukhārī heard him directly.
The speaker of the report.

records.en: Musaddad narrated to us, Isma’il b. Ibrahim narrated to us, Ziyad b. Mikhraq narrated to us, from Mu’awiyah b. Qurrah, from his father, who said A man said: "O Messenger of God, I slaughter the sheep while I have mercy on it," or: "I have mercy on the sheep from slaughtering it." He said: "As for the sheep, if you have mercy on it, God will have mercy on you," twice.

records.en: Ibrahim b. al-Mundhir narrated to us, Ma’n narrated to us, from Mu’awiyah, from Abd al-Rahman b. Jubayr b. Nufayr, from his father: from Nawwas b. Sam’an al-Ansari, that he asked the Messenger of God ﷺ about kindness and sin. He said "Kindness is good character, and sin is what troubles your soul, and you would hate for people to become aware of it."

chains.en: ʿAbd al-Raḥmān b. Jubayr b. Nufayr

records.en: Abu al-Yaman narrated to us, Shu’ayb informed us, from al-Zuhri, Salim narrated to me, from his father, who said: I heard the Messenger of God ﷺ while he was on the pulpit, saying: "Indeed, the trial is here," pointing toward the east, "from where the horn of Satan rises."

records.ar: حَدَّثَنَا الحُمَيْدِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ، حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَمْرِو بْنِ عَلْقَمَةَ، عَنْ يَحْيَى بْنِ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ حَاطِبٍ: عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ الزُّبَيْرِ، قَالَ: (قَالَ الزُّبَيْرُ ﵁ : لَمَّا نَزَلَتْ: {ثُمَّ إِنَّكُمْ يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ عِنْدَ رَبِّكُمْ تَخْتَصِمُونَ} . قَالَ الزُّبَيْرُ: يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ، يُكَرِّرُ عَلَيْنَا الخُصُومَةَ بَعْدَ الَّذِي كَانَ لَنَا فِي الدُّنْيَا، قَالَ: "نَعَمْ". قُلْتُ: إِنَّ الأَمْرَ لَشَدِيدٌ .
records.en: Al-Humaydi narrated to us, Sufyan narrated to us, Muhammad b. ‘Amr b. ‘Alqamah narrated to us, from Yahya b. ‘Abd al-Rahman b. Hatib: from ‘Abd Allah b. al-Zubayr, who said (Az-Zubayr ؓ said: When the verse was revealed: {Then indeed, you on the Day of Resurrection before your Lord will dispute} [Az-Zumar: 31], Az-Zubayr said: 'O Messenger of God, will the disputes we had in this world be repeated for us?' He said: 'Yes.' I said: 'Then the matter is indeed severe.')

chains.en: Yaḥyā b. ʿAbd al-Raḥmān b. Ḥāṭib
chains.ar: يحيى بن عبد الرحمن بن حاطب

records.ar: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عُبَيْدِ اللهِ أَبُو ثَابِتٍ المَدَنِيُّ، قَالَ [حَدَّثَنَا] عُمَرُ بْنُ طَلْحَةَ الوَقَّاصِيُّ، عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ عَمْرٍو، عَنْ يَحْيَى بْنِ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ، [قَالَ]: سَمِعْتُ عَبْدَ اللَّهِ بْنَ الزُّبَيْرِ، يَقُولُ: (لَمَّا نَزَلَتْ: {ثُمَّ إِنَّكُمْ يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ عِنْدَ رَبِّكُمْ تَخْتَصِمُونَ} . قَالَ الزُّبَيْرُ: يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ، يُكَرَّرُ عَلَيْنَا مَا كَانَ مِنَّا فِي الدُّنْيَا، مَعَ خَوَاصِّ الذُّنُوبِ؟ قَالَ: "نَعَمْ. لَيُكَرَّرَنَّ عَلَيْكُمْ، حَتَّى يُؤَدَّى إِلَى كُلِّ ذِي حَقٍّ حَقَّهُ". قَالَ الزُّبَيْرُ ﵁: وَاللَّهِ إِنَّ الأَمْرَ لَشَدِيدٌ) . قَالَ البُخَارِيُّ: "وَرَوَاهُ حَمَّادُ بْنُ سَلَمَةَ، عَنْ حَبِيبٍ، عَنِ الحَسَنِ، قَالَ الزُّبَيْرُ. وَرَوَاهُ شَدَّادُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، عَنْ غَيْلَانَ، عَنْ مُطَرِّفٍ، قَالَ: قَالَ الزُّبَيْرُ، وَأَلفَاظُهُمْ مُتَقَارِبَةٌ، وَالصَّحِيحُ حَدِيثُ الأَوَّلِ" .
records.en: Muhammad b. ‘Ubayd Allāh Abu Thabit al-Madani narrated to us, he said ‘Umar b. Talhah al-Waqqasi narrated to us, from Muhammad b. ‘Amr, from Yahya b. ‘Abd al-Rahman, [who said]: I heard ‘Abd Allah b. al-Zubayr say: (When the verse was revealed: {Then indeed, you on the Day of Resurrection before your Lord will dispute} [Az-Zumar: 31], Az-Zubayr said: 'O Messenger of God, will what occurred between us in this world be repeated, along with the specific sins?' He said: 'Yes, it will indeed be repeated for you until every rightful person receives their right.' Az-Zubayr ؓ said: 'By God, the matter is indeed severe.') Al-Bukhari said 'And it was narrated by Hammad b. Salamah, from Habib, from al-Hasan, that Az-Zubayr said. It was also narrated by Shaddad b. Sa‘id, from Ghaylan, from Mutarrif, who said: Az-Zubayr said. Their wordings are similar, and the correct narration is the first one.'

chains.en: Muḥammad b. ʿUbayd Allāh Abū Thābit al-Madanī

records.ar: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو الرَّبِيعِ سُلَيْمَانُ بْنُ دَاوُدَ، حَدَّثَنَا يَعْقُوبُ القُمِّيُّ ، حَدَّثَنَا جَعْفَرٌ، هُوَ: ابْنُ [أَبِي] المُغِيرَةِ، عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ جُبَيْرٍ: عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ، قَالَ: (لَمَّا نَزَلَتْ: {ثُمَّ إِنَّكُمْ يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ عِنْدَ رَبِّكُمْ تَخْتَصِمُونَ} . لَمْ نَدْرِ مَا تَفْسِيرُهَا؟ فَلَمَّا وَقَعَتِ الفِتْنَةُ، قُلْنَا هَذَا الَّذِي وَعَدَنَا رَبُّنَا أَنْ نَخْتَصِمَ فِيهِ) .
records.en: Abu al-Rabi‘ Sulayman b. Dawud narrated to us, Ya‘qub al-Qummi narrated to us, Ja‘far—who is Ibn Abi al-Mughirah—narrated to us, from Sa‘id b. Jubayr: from Ibn ‘Umar, who said: (When the verse was revealed: {Then indeed, you on the Day of Resurrection before your Lord will dispute} [Az-Zumar: 31], we did not know its interpretation. When the tribulation occurred, we said 'This is what our Lord promised us, that we would dispute over it.')

records.ar: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ كَثِيرٍ، أَخْبَرَنَا سُلَيْمَانُ بْنُ كَثِيرٍ، عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ، عَنْ عُرْوَةَ: عَنْ أُسَامَةَ بْنِ زَيْدٍ ، أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ ﷺ قَالَ: "هَلْ تَرَوْنَ مَا أَرَى؟ أَرَى الفِتَنَ تَقَعُ خِلَالَ بُيُوتِكُمْ" .
records.en: Muhammad b. Kathir narrated to us, Sulayman b. Kathir informed us, from az-Zuhri, from ‘Urwah: from Usamah b. Zayd, that the Prophet ﷺ said 'Do you see what I see? I see tribulations falling through your houses.'

records.ar: حَدَّثَنَا الفَضْلُ بْنُ دُكَيْنٍ، حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ عُيَيْنَةَ، عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ، عَنْ عُرْوَةَ: عَنْ أُسَامَةَ، قَالَ: قَالَ النَّبِيُّ ﷺ: "هَلْ تَرَوْنَ مَا أَرَى؟ إِنِّي لأَرَى مَوَاقِعَ الفِتَنِ خِلَالَ بُيُوتِكُمْ كَمَوَاقِعِ القَطْرِ " .
records.en: Al-Fadl b. Dukayn narrated to us, Ibn ‘Uyaynah narrated to us, from az-Zuhri, from ‘Urwah: from Usamah, who said The Prophet ﷺ said: 'Do you see what I see? Indeed, I see the places where tribulations will fall through your houses like the falling of rain.'

records.ar: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدَانُ ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ ، أَخْبَرَنَا مَعْمَرٌ، عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ، عَنْ عُرْوَةَ: عَنْ كُرْزِ بْنِ عَلْقَمَةَ ، قَالَ: (قَالَ أَعْرَابِيٌّ: لِلنَّبِيِّ ﷺ: هَلْ لِلإِسْلَامِ مُنْتَهًى؟ قَالَ: "نَعَمْ، أَيُّمَا أَهْلِ بَيْتٍ مِنَ العَرَبِ، أَوِ العَجَمِ، أَرَادَ اللَّهُ بِهِمْ خَيْرًا أَدْخَلَ عَلَيْهِمُ الإِسْلَامَ، ثُمَّ تَقَعُ الفِتَنُ كَأَنَّهَا الظُلَمُ". فَقَالَ الأَعْرَابِيُّ: كَلَّا، قَالَ: "بَلَى، وَالَّذِي نَفْسِي بِيَدِهِ، ثُمَّ تَعُودُنَّ فِيهَا أَسَاوِدَ صُبًّا ، يَضْرِبُ بَعْضُكُمْ رِقَابَ بَعْضٍ " .
records.en: ‘Abdan narrated to us, ‘Abd Allah narrated to us, Ma‘mar informed us, from az-Zuhri, from ‘Urwah: from Kurz b. ‘Alqamah, who said (A Bedouin said to the Prophet ﷺ: 'Is there an end to Islam?' He said: 'Yes. Any household among the Arabs or non-Arabs for whom God intends good, He admits Islam to them; then trials will fall like patches of darkness.' The Bedouin said: 'Never!' He said: 'Indeed, by the One in Whose Hand is my soul, you will then return to it as serpents pouring down, some of you striking the necks of others.')

chains.role: Named only as ʿAbd Allāh.

records.en: Narrated ‘Abdullah b. Salih: Layth narrated to me, from Nafi‘, from ‘Abdullah (ibn ‘Umar), that he heard the Messenger of God ﷺ while he was facing the east, say: "Behold! The trial is here—behold! The trial is from here, from where the horn of Satan rises."

records.ar: حَدَّثَنَا آدَمُ بْنُ أَبِي إِيَاسٍ، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، حَدَّثَنَا عُيَيْنَةُ بْنُ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ، سَمِعْتُ أَبِي يُحَدِّثُ: عَنْ أَبِي بَكْرَةَ، قَالَ: قَالَ النَّبِيُّ ﷺ: "مَا مِنْ ذَنْبٍ أَحْرَى أَنْ يُعَجِّلَ اللَّهُ لِصَاحِبِهِ العُقُوبَةَ فِي الدُّنْيَا، مَعَ مَا يَدَّخِرُ لَهُ فِي الآخِرَةِ، مِنْ قَطِيعَةِ الرَّحِمِ وَالبَغْيِ" .
records.en: Narrated Adam b. Abi Iyas: Shu‘bah narrated to us, from ‘Uyaynah b. ‘Abd al-Rahman, who heard his father narrating from Abu Bakrah, who said The Prophet ﷺ said: "There is no sin more deserving of God hastening punishment in this world, along with what He has stored for its doer in the Hereafter, than severing kinship ties and oppression."

chains.role: The father of ʿUyayna b. ʿAbd al-Raḥmān; the text reads «سمعت أبي».

records.ar: حَدَّثَنَا أُمَيَّةُ بْنُ بِسْطَامٍ، حَدَّثَنَا يَزِيدُ بْنُ زُرَيْعٍ، عَنِ العَلَاءِ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ: عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، قَالَ: أَتَى رَجُلٌ النَّبِيَّ ﷺ فَقَالَ: إِنَّ لِي قَرَابَةً أَصِلُهُمْ وَيَقْطَعُونَ، وَأَحْلُمُ عَنْهُمْ وَيَجْهَلُونَ عَلَيَّ، وَأُحْسِنُ إِلَيْهِمْ وَيُسِيئُونَ إِلَيَّ، قَالَ: "لَئِنْ كَانَ كَمَا تَقُولُ كَأَنَّمَا تُسِفُّهُمُ المَلَّ ، وَلَا يَزَالُ مَعَكَ مِنَ اللَّهِ ظَهِيرٌ [عَلَيْهِمْ] مَا دُمْتَ عَلَى ذَلِكَ") .
records.en: Umayyah b. Bistam narrated to us, Yazid b. Zuray‘ narrated to us, from al-‘Ala’, from his father: from Abu Hurayrah, who said A man came to the Prophet ﷺ and said: 'I have relatives whom I maintain ties with, but they sever them; I overlook their faults, but they treat me with ignorance; I treat them well, but they treat me badly.' He said: 'If what you say is true, it is as if you are feeding them hot ashes, and you will always have support from God against them as long as you persist in this.'

records.ar: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ كَثِيرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ، عَنِ الأَعْمَشِ، وَالحَسَنِ بْنِ عَمْرٍو، وَفِطْرٍ، عَنْ مُجَاهِدٍ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عَمْرٍو، قَالَ سُفْيَانُ: وَلَمْ يَرْفَعْهُ الأَعْمَشُ إِلَى النَّبِيِّ ﷺ، وَرَفَعَهُ الحَسَنُ وَفِطْرٌ، إِلَى النَّبِيِّ ﷺ قَالَ: "لَيْسَ الوَاصِلُ بِالمُكَافِئِ، وَلَكِنَّ الوَاصِلَ الَّذِي تَوَلَّتْ رَحِمُهُ وَصَلَهَا" .
records.en: Muhammad b. Kathir narrated to us, Sufyan narrated to us, from al-A‘mash, al-Hasan b. ‘Amr, and Fitr, from Mujahid, from ‘Abdullah b. ‘Amr, who said Sufyan said: Al-A‘mash did not attribute it to the Prophet ﷺ but al-Hasan and Fitr did. He said: 'The one who maintains ties is not the one who merely reciprocates; rather, the one who maintains ties is the one whose relatives turn away from him and he still keeps ties with them.'

records.ar: حَدَّثَنَا مَالِكُ بْنُ إِسْمَاعِيلَ، حَدَّثَنَا عِيسَى بْنُ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ، عَنْ طَلْحَةَ، عَنْ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ عَوْسَجَةَ: عَنِ البَرَاءِ ﵁ ، قَالَ: (جَاءَ أَعْرَابِيٌّ فَقَالَ: يَا نَبِيَّ اللَّهِ، عَلِّمْنِي عَمَلًا يُدْخِلُنِي الجَنَّةَ، قَالَ: "لَئِنْ كُنْتَ أَقَصَرْتَ الخُطْبَةَ لَقَدْ أَعْرَضْتَ المَسْأَلَةَ ، أَعْتِقِ النَّسَمَةَ ، وَفُكَّ الرَّقَبَةَ". قَالَ: أَوَ لَيْسَتَا وَاحِدًا ؟ قَالَ: "لَا، عِتْقُ النَّسَمَةِ أَنْ تَعْتِقَ النَّسَمَةَ ، وَفَكُّ الرَّقَبَةِ أَنْ تُعِينَ عَلَى الرَّقَبَةِ ، وَالمَنِيحَةُ الوَكُوفُ ، وَالفَيْءُ عَلَى ذِي الرَّحِمِ الظَّالِمِ ، فَإِنْ لَمْ تُطِقْ [ذَلِكَ]، فَتَأْمُرَ بِالمَعْرُوفِ، وَانْهَ عَنِ المُنْكَرِ، فَإِنْ لَمْ تُطِقْ [ذَلِكَ]، فَكُفَّ لِسَانَكَ إِلَّا مِنْ خَيْرٍ") .
records.en: Malik b. Isma‘il narrated to us, ‘Isa b. ‘Abd al-Rahman narrated to us, from Talhah, from ‘Abd al-Rahman b. ‘Awsajah: from al-Bara’ ؓ who said A Bedouin came and said: 'O Prophet of God, teach me a deed that will admit me to Paradise.' He said: 'Though you have kept your words short, you have asked a vast question. Free a soul and release a neck.' He said: 'Are they not the same?' He said: 'No. Freeing a soul is to free a person yourself; releasing a neck is to help pay for the freeing. And [give] the loan of a richly milking animal (al-minḥa al-wakūf), and return kindness to the wrongdoing relative. If you cannot do that, then enjoin good and forbid evil. If you cannot do that, then restrain your tongue except from what is good.'

records.ar: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو اليَمَانِ، أَخْبَرَنَا شُعَيْبٌ، عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ، أَخْبَرَنِي عُرْوَةُ بْنُ الزُّبَيْرِ، أَنَّ حَكِيمَ بْنَ حِزَامٍ ، أَخْبَرَهُ: أَنَّهُ قَالَ لِرَسُولِ اللَّهِ ﷺ: (أَرَأَيْتَ أُمُورًا كُنْتُ أَتَحَنَّثُ، أَوْ أَتَحَنَّتُ بِهَا فِي الجَاهِلِيَّةِ، مِنْ صِلَةٍ وَعَتَاقَةٍ وَصَدَقَةٍ، هَلْ لِي فِيهَا أَجْرٌ؟ قَالَ حَكِيمٌ: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ: "أَسْلَمْتَ عَلَى مَا سَلَفَ مِنْ خَيْرٍ") .
records.en: Abu al-Yaman narrated to us, Shu‘ayb informed us, from al-Zuhri, ‘Urwah b. al-Zubayr informed me that Hakim b. Hizam informed him: that he said to the Messenger of God ﷺ: 'Do you see the deeds I used to perform in the pre-Islamic era, such as maintaining ties of kinship, freeing slaves, and giving charity—will I have a reward for them?' Hakim said The Messenger of God ﷺ said: 'You have embraced Islam with the good you had previously done.'

records.en: ‘Abd al-Rahman b. Sharik narrated to us, his father narrated to us, from Muhammad b. Ishaq, from Bukayr b. ‘Abdullah b. al-Ashajj, from Sulayman b. Yasar: from Maymunah, the wife of the Prophet ﷺ and ؓ: that she freed a slave girl of hers. The Messenger of God ﷺ entered upon her and she mentioned it to him. He said 'God has rewarded you. If you had given her to your maternal uncles, your reward would have been greater.'

records.display_matn_ar: (أَنَّ مَيْمُونَةَ زَوْجَ النَّبِيِّ ﷺ، أَعْتَقَتْ وَلِيدَةً لَهَا، فَقَالَ لَهَا: "لَوْ وَصَلْتِ بَعْضَ أَخْوَالِكِ كَانَ أَعْظَمَ لِأَجْرِكِ") .

records.ar: حَدَّثَنَا بِشْرُ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ، أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ ، أَخْبَرَنَا مُعَاوِيَةُ بْنُ أَبِي مُزَرِّدٍ، سَمِعْتُ عَمِّي سَعِيدَ بْنَ يَسَارٍ، يُحَدِّثُ: عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ ﷺ قَالَ: "إِنَّ اللَّهَ خَلَقَ الخَلْقَ، حَتَّى إِذَا فَرَغَ مِنْ خَلْقِهِ، قَالَتِ الرَّحِمُ: هَذَا مَقَامُ العَائِذِ بِكَ مِنَ القَطِيعَةِ، قَالَ: نَعَمْ، أَلَا تَرْضَيْنَ أَنْ أَصِلَ مَنْ وَصَلَكِ، وَأَقْطَعَ مَنْ قَطَعَكِ؟ قَالَتْ: بَلَى يَا رَبِّ، قَالَ: فَهُوَ لَكِ". قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ: "فَاقْرَءُوا إِنْ شِئْتُمْ": {فَهَلْ عَسَيْتُمْ إِنْ تَوَلَّيْتُمْ أَنْ تُفْسِدُوا فِي الْأَرْضِ وَتُقَطِّعُوا أَرْحَامَكُمْ (22) أُولَئِكَ الَّذِينَ لَعَنَهُمُ اللَّهُ فَأَصَمَّهُمْ وَأَعْمَى أَبْصَارَهُمْ} " .
records.en: Bishr b. Muhammad narrated to us, ‘Abdullah informed us, Mu‘awiyah b. Abi Muzarrad informed us, I heard my uncle Sa‘id b. Yasar narrating: from Abu Hurayrah, from the Prophet ﷺ who said 'God created the creation, and when He finished, the kinship said: This is the station of the one seeking refuge in You from being severed. He said: Yes, are you not pleased that I maintain ties with those who maintain ties with you and sever ties with those who sever ties with you? She said: Yes, O Lord. He said: That is for you.' The Messenger of God ﷺ said: 'Recite if you wish: {Would you then, if you were given authority, cause corruption in the land and sever your ties of kinship? Those are the ones whom God has cursed, so He deafened them and blinded their eyes.} [Muhammad: 22-23]'

records.display_text_ar: حَدَّثَنَا بِشْرُ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ، أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ ، أَخْبَرَنَا مُعَاوِيَةُ بْنُ أَبِي مُزَرِّدٍ، سَمِعْتُ عَمِّي سَعِيدَ بْنَ يَسَارٍ، يُحَدِّثُ: عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ ﷺ قَالَ: "إِنَّ اللَّهَ خَلَقَ الخَلْقَ، حَتَّى إِذَا فَرَغَ مِنْ خَلْقِهِ، قَالَتِ الرَّحِمُ: هَذَا مَقَامُ العَائِذِ بِكَ مِنَ القَطِيعَةِ، قَالَ: نَعَمْ، أَلَا تَرْضَيْنَ أَنْ أَصِلَ مَنْ وَصَلَكِ، وَأَقْطَعَ مَنْ قَطَعَكِ؟ قَالَتْ: بَلَى يَا رَبِّ، قَالَ: فَهُوَ لَكِ". قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ: "فَاقْرَءُوا إِنْ شِئْتُمْ": {فَهَلْ عَسَيْتُمْ إِنْ تَوَلَّيْتُمْ أَنْ تُفْسِدُوا فِي الْأَرْضِ وَتُقَطِّعُوا أَرْحَامَكُمْ (22) أُولَئِكَ الَّذِينَ لَعَنَهُمُ اللَّهُ فَأَصَمَّهُمْ وَأَعْمَى أَبْصَارَهُمْ} " .

records.ar: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ يُوسُفَ، حَدَّثَنَا اللَّيْثُ، عَنْ عُقَيْلٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ، سَمِعْتُ عُرْوَةَ، يَقُولُ: قَالَتْ عَائِشَةُ ﵂: (فَرَجَعَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ إِلَى خَدِيجَةَ ﵂ ، تَرْجُفُ بَوَادِرُهُ ، فَدَخَلَ وَقَالَ: "زَمِّلُونِي زَمِّلُونِي "، فَلَمَّا سُرِّيَ عَنْهُ، قَالَ ﷺ لِخَدِيجَةَ: أَشْفَقْتُ عَلَى نَفْسِي، قَالَتْ خَدِيجَةُ ﵂: أَبْشِرْ، فَوَاللَّهِ لَا يُخْزِيكَ اللَّهُ أَبَدًا، إِنَّكَ لَتَصْدُقُ الحَدِيثَ، وَتَصِلُ الرَّحِمَ، وَتَحْمِلُ الكَلَّ ، وَتَقْرِي الضَّيْفَ ، وَتُعِينُ عَلَى نَوَائِبِ الحَقِّ ، فَانْطَلَقَتْ بِهِ خَدِيجَةُ إِلَى وَرَقَةَ بْنِ نَوْفَلِ بْنِ أَسَدٍ، وَكَانَ تَنَصَّرَ، شَيْخٌ أَعْمَى، يَقْرَأُ الإِنْجِيلَ بِالعَرَبِيَّةِ، [فَـ] قَالَتْ لَهُ خَدِيجَةُ: أَيْ عَمِّ، اسْمَعْ مِنَ ابْنِ أَخِيكَ، فَقَالَ لَهُ وَرَقَةُ: يَا ابْنَ أَخِي مَاذَا تَرَى؟ فَأَخْبَرَهُ خَبَرَ مَا رَأَى، فَقَالَ وَرَقَةُ: هَذَا النَّامُوسُ الَّذِي أَنْزَلَ اللهُ عَلَى مُوسَى، يَا لَيْتَنِي فِيهَا جَذَعًا ، يَا لَيْتَنِي أَكُونُ حَيًّا حِينَ يُخْرِجُكَ قَوْمُكَ، قَالَ: "أَوَ مُخْرِجِيَّ هُمْ؟ " قَالَ: نَعَمْ، لَمْ يَأْتِ رَجُلٌ [بِـ] مَا جِئْتَ بِهِ قَطُّ إِلَّا عُودِيَ، وَإِنْ يُدْرِكْنِي يَوْمُكَ أَنْصُرْكَ نَصْرًا مُؤَزَّرًا) .
records.en: ‘Abdullah b. Yusuf narrated to us, al-Layth narrated to us, from ‘Uqayl, from Ibn Shihab, I heard ‘Urwah say: ‘A’ishah ؓ said The Messenger of God ﷺ returned to Khadijah ؓ his limbs trembling. He entered and said: 'Wrap me up, wrap me up.' When his fear subsided, he said to Khadijah: 'I feared for myself.' Khadijah ؓ said: 'Rejoice, for by God, God will never disgrace you. You speak the truth, maintain ties of kinship, bear the burdens of others, honor the guest, and assist in matters of truth.' Then Khadijah took him to Waraqah b. Nawfal b. Asad, who had embraced Christianity. He was an old, blind man who read the Gospel in Arabic. Khadijah said to him: 'O uncle, listen to your nephew.' Waraqah said to him: 'O son of my brother, what do you see?' He informed him of what he had seen. Waraqah said: 'This is the Namus whom God sent to Moses. I wish I were young; I wish I were alive when your people drive you out.' He said: 'Will they drive me out?' He said: 'Yes, no man has ever come with what you have brought except that he was opposed. If I live to see your day, I will support you with strong support.'

records.ar: حَدَّثَنَا سُلَيْمَانُ بْنُ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ، حَدَّثَنَا الوَلِيدُ بْنُ مُسْلِمٍ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ العَلَاءِ، وَغَيْرُهُ ، أَنَّهُمَا سَمِعَا بِلَالَ بْنَ سَعْدٍ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ ﵃ : "أَنَّهُ قَالَ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ، مَا لِلخَلِيفَةِ مِنْ بَعْدِكِ؟ قَالَ: "مِثْلُ الَّذِي لِي، مَا عَدْلَ فِي الحَكَمِ، وَقَسَطَ فِي البَسْطِ ، وَرَحِمَ ذَا الرَّحِمِ، فَمَنْ فَعَلَ غَيْرَ ذَلِكَ فَلَيْسَ مِنِّي، وَلَسْتُ مِنْهُ". قَالَ: يُرِيدُ الطَّاعَةَ فِي طَاعَةِ اللهِ، وَالمَعْصِيَةَ فِي مَعْصِيَةِ اللَّهِ ﷻ .
records.en: Sulayman b. ‘Abd al-Rahman narrated to us, al-Walid b. Muslim narrated to us, ‘Abdullah b. al-‘Ala’ and others narrated to us, that they heard Bilal b. Sa‘d, from his father ؓ: That he said: 'O Messenger of God, what [reward] does the caliph have after you?' He said: 'The like of what I have, so long as he is just in judgment, fair in distribution, and merciful to those of his kin. Whoever does otherwise is not from me, and I am not from him.' The narrator said: he means obedience [to the caliph] in what is obedience to God, and disobedience in what is disobedience to God ﷻ.

records.ar: حَدَّثَنَا قُتَيْبَةُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا اللَّيْثُ، عَنْ أَبِي الزُّبَيْرِ: عَنْ جَابِرٍ ﵁، أَنَّهُ قَالَ: أَعْتَقَ رَجُلٌ مِنْ بَنِي عُذْرَةَ عَبْدًا لَهُ عَنْ دُبُرٍ ، فَبَلَغَ ذَلِكَ رَسُولَ اللهِ ﷺ فَقَالَ: "لَكَ مَالٌ غَيْرُهُ؟ " فَقَالَ: لَا، فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ: "مَنْ يَشْتَرِيهِ مِنِّي"، فَاشْتَرَاهُ نُعَيْمُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللهِ النَّحَّامُ ، بِثَمَانِ مِائَةِ دِرْهَمٍ، فَجَاءَ بِهَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ، فَدَفَعَهَا إِلَيْهِ، ثُمَّ قَالَ: "ابْدَأْ بِنَفْسِكَ فَتَصَدَّقْ عَلَيْهَا، فَإِنْ فَضَلَ شَيْءٌ [فَلِأَهْلِكَ، فَإِنْ فَضَلَ عَنْ أَهْلِكَ شَيْءٌ فَلِذِي قَرَابَتِكَ، فَإِنْ فَضَلَ] عَنْ [ذِي] قَرَابَتِكَ [شَيْءٌ] ، فَهَكَذَا، وَهَكَذَا "، يَقُولُ: بَيْنَ يَدَيْكَ وَعَنْ يَمِينِكَ وَعَنْ شِمَالِكَ) .
records.en: Qutaybah b. Sa‘eed narrated to us, Al-Layth narrated to us, from Abu Az-Zubayr, from Jaabir ؓ that he said A man from Banu ‘Udhrah emancipated a slave of his upon his death. This reached the Messenger of God ﷺ so he said: "Do you have any wealth besides him?" The man said: No. The Messenger of God ﷺ then said: "Who will buy him from me?" So Nu‘aym b. ‘Abdullah An-Nahhaam bought him for eight hundred dirhams. He brought the money to the Messenger of God ﷺ and he gave it to him. Then he said "Begin with yourself and give charity to it. If anything remains, then for your family. If anything remains after your family, then for your relatives. If anything remains after your relatives, then like this and like this," meaning: in front of you, to your right, and to your left.

records.ar: حَدَّثَنَا آدَمُ بْنُ أَبِي إِيَاسٍ، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، قَالَ ابْنُ أَبِي ذِئْبٍ ، حَدَّثَنَا سَعِيدُ بْنُ سَمْعَانَ : سَمِعْتُ أَبَا هُرَيْرَةَ ﵁: "يَتَعَوَّذُ مِنْ إِمَارَةِ الصِّبْيَانِ وَالسُّفَهَاءِ" . فَقَالَ سَعِيدُ بْنُ سَمْعَانَ: فَأَخْبَرَنِي ابْنُ حَسَنَةَ الجُهَنِيُّ أَنَّهُ قَالَ لِأَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ: مَا آيَةُ ذَلِكَ؟، قَالَ: أَنْ تُقْطَعَ الأَرْحَامُ، وَيُطَاعَ المُغْوِي، وَيُعْصَى المُرْشِدُ .
records.en: Aadam b. Abi Iyaas narrated to us, Shu‘bah narrated to us. Ibn Abi Dhi’b said Sa‘eed b. Sam‘aan narrated to us: I heard Abu Hurayrah ؓ seeking refuge from the rule of boys and fools. Sa‘eed b. Sam‘aan said: Ibn Hasanah Al-Juhani informed me that he said to Abu Hurayrah: What is the sign of that? He said: When kinship ties are severed, the misguiding are obeyed, and the rightly guided are disobeyed.

records.display_text_ar: حَدَّثَنَا آدَمُ بْنُ أَبِي إِيَاسٍ، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ ، عَنْ سُلَيْمَانَ التَّيْمِيِّ، قَالَ: سَمِعْتُ أَبَا عُثْمَانَ النَّهْدِيَّ: عَنْ أُسَامَةَ بْنِ زَيْدٍ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ ﷺ قَالَ: "مَا تَرَكْتُ بَعْدِي فِتْنَةً أَضَرَّ عَلَى الرِّجَالِ مِنَ النِّسَاءِ" .

records.display_matn_ar: "مَا تَرَكْتُ بَعْدِي فِتْنَةً أَضَرَّ عَلَى الرِّجَالِ مِنَ النِّسَاءِ" .

records.ar: آخِرُ الكِتَابِ، وَالحَمْدُ للَّهِ عَلَى كُلِّ حَالٍ. عَلَّقَهُ لِنَفْسِهِ العَبْدُ مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ مُحَمَّدِ مَنْصُورٍ بْنِ عَلِيٍّ الحُسَيْنِيُّ الحَلَبِيُّ، نَهَارَ الثُّلَاثَاءِ 28 شَوَّالٍ، سَنَةَ 887، بِعُلُوِّ جَامِعِ الأَزْهَرِ بِالقَاهِرَةِ، حَمَاهَا اللَّهُ تَعَالَى. اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى سَيِّدَنَا مُحَمَّدٍ، وَآلِه وَصَحْبِهِ وَسَلَّم .
records.en: The end of the book, and all praise is due to God in every circumstance. Noted for himself the servant Muhammad b. Muhammad Mansoor b. Alee al-Husaynee al-Halabee, on the day of Tuesday, the 28th of Shawwaal, in the year 887, at the upper part of al-Azhar Mosque in Cairo, may God ﷻ protect it. O God, send prayers upon our master Muhammad, and his family and companions, and grant them peace.
